steps.text: Transfer the US$250 minimum - the sum stays in your trading balance, it is not a fee.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Choose the risk settings and execution mode, then start with the practice balance.

pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: Payout wording without processing detail.
No named regulator or licence.
Withdrawal fees the page omits.
Support channels not clearly listed.
redFlags: Return claims without verification.
The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.
Restriction lists that name different countries.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.
9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
The scorecard settles at 4.6. That is a cautious pass - proceed with the demo first, the minimum deposit second, and treat every payout figure as unproven until you see it yourself.
